batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b S Sreesanth

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b BJ Hodge

batting.name: PR Shah
batting.dismissal: c Y Gnaneswara Rao b BJ Hodge

batting.name: ND Doshi
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b P Parameswaran

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c AA Chavan b JDP Oram

balls.text: Rajasthan have been bowled out, Doshi attempts a swat, on the leg side, miscue again and Jayawardene takes a dolly at midwicket
shortish on the off, attempts a similar shot, miscues it and Hodge at extra cover runs in to clasp that, a low one-handed attempt, dropped in the end, a tough one
smashed down the ground, short outside off and he moves away to swat that past long-off
with a slinging action this time, lands it on a length outside off, pushed straight to extra cover
full toss on middle, pushed straight to extra cover
Doshi goes after that one this time, full outside off and he tries to smash it down the ground, no contact
short of a good length on middle, nicely behind it and taps it to cover
yorker and Tait just manages to squeeze it out towards deep point
targeting middle and off, Tait moves away and defends him to point
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and defends him to point
around a good length pokes at that one and misses again
beaten this time as he invites him to play a drive with a full delivery, Doshi pushes and misses
good length and it zips through him as he steps back to play the cut
full and wide and Doshi doesn't bother going for it
short and wide, cuts it hard to third man for a single
will be disappointed, slips in a short and wide delivery that Doshi wisely lets go, no five-for but he's put Kochi in complete control with his spell
short and wide, tries to cut that, doesn't make contact
full and wide and Doshi keeps Hodge interested, goes for a drive but misses
short of a good length, gets back and punches it to extra cover

Rajasthan are throwing it away, four for Hodge, tossed up on middle, Menaria made plenty of room to loft it over long-off, got plenty of elevation and it landed safely in the palms of Owais Shah waiting there for exactly that
short ball outside off and it's swatted hard past the diving extra cover in the deep for a couple of runs
worked away through square leg to keep strike
quicker ball and Menaria couldn't pick it, too late to play it and by the time he attempts a shot it's gone past him
slung it full on middle, driven straight to long-on for a single
comes down the track and tries to swing that over midwicket, gets an inside edge onto the pads
full toss on middle and leg, punched past midwicket for a single
fires in a wide well outside off, called by the umpire
dug out into the leg side wide of midwicket for a single
flighted outside off, driven straight to extra cover

run-out, Rajasthan in disarray, guided to short third man, Chavan wanted a single and kept running through even as Menaria turned back, it's a wayward throw to the bowler's end and Hodge collects it yards away from the stumps, recovers well to take off the bails and catch him well short
short ball outside off, slapped towards deep cover for a single
pitched up on the off, driven back to the bowler
fullish outside off, gets a stride out to defend it to extra cover
gone, gone! Warne drags it on, flat delivery well outside off and he tries to sweep it square, gets an inside edge straight onto the off stump, tame dismissal there, Kochi are on top
short of a good length outside off, chopped straight to point
full toss outside off, cracked towards deep point for a single
shortish outside off, chopped down to point
another appeal for lbw and this looks closer, much straighter and heading for middle as Warne misses it again when trying to close the face, not given but this one was gone for sure

comes round the wicket, angling towards leg, walks across to work it into the leg side, misses, appeal for lbw  turned down, the umpire thought it was going down leg though the replays show it would have clipped leg stump
nicely timed again by Menaria, driven elegantly wide of Owais Shah at long-off for a brace
gets across and works it behind square leg for a single
slightly short on the off, chopped down towards point
flighted outside off, played straight to extra cover

Oram goes for a duck, a slightly quicker delivery landing on leg, Oram lazily tries to drive it through the line, misses, it deflects off the pads onto the off stump which is knocked down, will Rajasthan survive the 20 overs?
floating it outside off from round the wicket, guided towards short third man
good length outside off, opens the face and steers it wide of point where Jadeja dives and prevents the single
a bit more pace on that one, targeting middle and off, drags it down to deep square leg
slower one bowled short outside off, cut straight to point
two more, pushing it on a length on middle and leg, clipped away past square leg into the deep, Owais slides to keep them to a couple
timed it well, slower one bowled short on middle, punched hard past midwicket, plenty of legs on that to beat the fielder in the deep
swing, swung in towards leg stump, tries to work it square, was struck on the pads
tossed up on the off, driven straight back to the bowler

shortish on the off, punches it hard to extra cover, there's a fumble and they decide to steal a single, Ravindra Jadeja picks it up from point and aims hard at the non-striker's end, misses, that's a missed run-out
quicker through the air, bowled on a length outside off and he goes for the slog-sweep, mistimes it as it comes off the bottom of the bat, Rao makes no mistake at long-on, simple chance
flighted on the off, pushed back to the bowler
Pinal handles that with some more force, shortish and it's swatted hard past midwicket for a boundary
round the wicket, bowled fullish on leg stump, pushed towards midwicket
short of a good length, eased into the gap past cover for a single

bowled'im, a bit of extra pace on that one from Parameswaran, quick delivery bowled full on leg stump, Watson tries to drive it through midwicket, a touch too fast for the man, misses and it clips the pads on the way to knocking back leg
shortish on middle, punched off the back foot wide of midwicket for a quick single
bowled on a length this time, it's played down the ground to long-on for a single
drops it down in front of point for a quick single
the fun continues, short and wide, there to be hit and Menaria cashes in, slashing him over point
overcompensates this time, gifting Watto a full toss, it's drilled back over his head and over long-on for a flat crowd-killer
short and it's gone again but nowhere as far as the previous one, still enough strength to clear the deep midwicket fence, poor length and it's getting the treatment
tries to slog-sweep that over midwicket but can't get hold, it's well fielded by Jayawardene who returns an inaccurate throw as Watson contemplates a single that wasn't on
quicker through the air on middle, pushed gently into the leg side this time
that's disappeared, Bangladesh revisited for Watson, short ball, a long hop that's dispatched over the roof behind the midwicket boundary, a Watson special that
quicker, short on middle and leg, tries to whip it square, gets an inside edge on the pads
slower one, rocks back to pull it over midwicket, a desperate attempt in the deep but he fails to drag that in
shortish outside off, chops it down to point, a mistimed cut that
short of a good length, pokes at that one, attempting to run it down to third man, misses
back of a length, an attempted bouncer, called a wide for height
shortish on the off, rocks back and knocks it towards cover
back of a length outside off, chopped behind point, Watson wants a single but is rightly sent back, Jadeja misses on the direct hit
pitched up outside off, Watson drives hard through the line to long-off for just the single
lands in the stands, short of a good length and he launches into that one, width again and he stands tall to smash it over the extra cover boundary
pitched up outside off, tries to caress it through cover, there was enough width to do it but mistimed it
nipped back in, goodish length and Menaria, who has it well covered, tries to play it into the off but gets a thick inside edge towards midwicket
back of a length on the off, rocks back to knock it down
Rajasthan in a bit of trouble, Rahane shuffled a little too much there, bowled it on a length and went on straight, Rahane tried to clip it to square leg, missed and was caught right in front
Outstanding stuff, just a Laxmanesque flick, fetched it from outside off and whipped it through midwicket, raced away
nips in, round the wicket and jags in towards middle, fends it into the leg side after he realises he is cramped for space
superbly fielded at extra cover by McCullum, pitched up and it's driven hard but to extra cover where McCullum flings himself to his right
drops it short on middle, gets into position early and pulls it to deep square leg for a single
fires it on a length just outside leg, he walks across to clip it over square leg but makes no contact with the bat, is struck on the pads prompting a stifled appeal
held it back again, punched off the back foot towards extra cover
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and defends it in front of the bowler
shortish with a bit of away movement again, chopped wide of second slip
short of a good length on the off, drops it on the off side, calls for a single but Rahane sends him back
gets forward and pushes it for a well-run single
goodish length on the off, a hint of away movement, defended towards cover
lands on a good length on middle, gets back and turns it away past square leg for a single

The openers have fallen in successive deliveries, lovely outswinger from Sreesanth, lands on a driving length and Dravid chases it, gets a thick edge and Owais Shah, standing at a widish slip, makes no mistake, taking a good low chance

trapped in front, full toss on middle and Fazal tries to work it around, turns the face and he misses, is struck on the pads, appeared as though he was struck in front of middle and off, that's got to be out
short of a good length on middle and leg, turned away past midwicket for a couple of runs
flat, really flat and lands just short of the ropes, good length and he seizes the chance, smashing it hard over midwicket for a one bounce four
bowled full on the off, tries to drive it to cover, the bat turns and he plays it back to the bowler instead, RP throws down the stumps at the striker's end and appeals, but nothing comes out of it
short and wide and it's slashed hard, well past the diving Owais Shah at slip who dives full length but can't reach it
played uppishly towards cover off the front foot
back of a length outside off, tries to pull it square into the leg side, gets a thick inside edge
straying on the pads, clipped away towards deep square leg for a single
short of a good length on the off, nips away just a bit, played towards point
fullish on the off, there is some movement away from the batsman in the air, defended firmly to extra cover
down the leg side, walks across to clip it fine, kisses the pads on the way to the keeper who fumbles and they sneak a leg bye
swinging in and Fazal tries to drive it through the on side, gets an inside edge onto the pads, thinks of a single but is sent back wisely
lovely shot, pitched up outside off, leans into the drive and plays it straight to extra cover, he would think that shot deserved more
shortish outside off, gets back and chops it towards point

short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot to defend it on the off side and we have a mess, a needless throw from point from Ravindra Jadeja and he concedes four overthrows, Sunil Gavaskar is livid in the commentary box and so is everyone on the field
makes contact this time but cant beat backward point
good ball outside off, Fazal feels for it and gets beaten
turned away wide of midwicket to complete a thumping win for Kochi
slightly short on the off, pushed to mid-on
scores level, landed in the slot on middle, made room and smacked him over mid-on for a one-bounce four
the bouncer, tries to pull it into the stands but couldn't connect
short and Hodge is unstoppable here, picks the length early, gets into position and smotes him over midwicket
short and wide, tries to slash it over point, the shot was on but he couldn't connect
short and way too wide, called by the umpire
good length, he makes room and swats it straight to mid-off
back of a length on middle, gets back and knocks it into the off side
poor delivery once more, short again, another long hop and he helps it on its way to the deep square-leg boundary
six more, short on middle, a long hop, runs back and pulls it hard over square leg for another flat six
went for the slog-sweep, fullish, got an inside edge on the pads
held it back and pushed it slower, came down the track and played it to the bowler
slightly short on middle and off, knocked down into the off side
straying on the pads and it clips the pads on its way to the fine-leg boundary
nice timing again, fullish on leg stump, pushed firmly past midwicket for a couple of runs
Parthiv looking in fine touch, pulls off an almost identical shot, again it's past the cover fielder, found the gap perfectly
lovey shot, short of a good length, stands tall and punches him hard through the covers
gets back and turns it down towards fine leg for a single
short o a good length, punched to extra cover, attempts an impossible single and Menaria misses the stumps at the non-striker's end, Parthiv was a gonner otherwise
short of a length on middle, pulled past square leg for a couple of runs
they're trying to finish it quickly, Hodge uses his feet again to just chip that over the bowler's head, superb timing as it clears long-off comfortably
sweetly struck, flighted on middle, Hodge comes down the track again to get to the pitch and drives him hard down the ground to beat the diving mid-on fielder
flighted on middle and off, gets forward and drops it down into the off side
Hodge wasting no time, tossed up, comes down the track, gets under it and lofts him clean over mid-on
floating it on the off stump, Hodge gets a stride out and is struck on the pads as he tries to defend, stifled appeal turned down
dismisses McCullum, big relief for Rajasthan, McCullum dances down the track to smash him over midwicket, a touch too early he swings the bat, misses and it deflects off the pads onto the stumps
bowled it full on the off, dug out towards cover, thinks of a single but decides against it at the end
back of a length outside off, tempted to play the upper cut again but backs out at the right time
shortish but down the leg side and it's called a wide
back of a length outside off, punched to point off the back foot
upper cut for six, quick is Tait and it's short outside off, Parthiv plays that shot well, slashing it over third man
banged in short outside off, drops his hands on that one and lets it go
bowled full outside off, driven straight to mid-off
three against Oram, full again, doling out deliveries on the spot, McCullum walks across just a hint and hammers him for another flat one, Rajasthan are speechless
full outside off, reaches for it and plays it to point
full and McCullum's in a violent mood here, gives the bowler the treatment again, launching him over his head once more but much flatter this time, ferocious hit
he's holed out, lovely shot but there was a deep square leg in place, walked across to that straight delivery and clipped it straight to Chavan in the deep, Rajasthan have struck
full toss that McCullum fails to dispatch, only squeezes a single past square leg
McCullum showing no mercy towards his New Zealand team-mate, it's a length ball and he comes down the track to crash it high and handsome over the bowler's head
short of a good length on middle, played through square leg again for a couple, expensive start for Rajasthan
Kochi are running away with this, good length on middle and leg and Jayawardene begins in classy fashion, clipping it through square leg for a boundary
length ball and McCullum wants to swing it out of Indore, gets a top edge and Menaria and Pinal, the wicketkeeper, collide trying to go for it, predictably it's a drop

just as I said that, fires it full on middle and McCullum's already charged out, tries to squeeze it past cover but it's a too quick, can't dig it out and the stumps are splayed, middle and leg out of the ground. Wait a minute. The umpire wants to cross check if that's a back foot no-ball, and replays show it is. The back foot was touching the side crease, McCullum gets a life. Tait has had this problem. Freehit again
short ball outside off, stands tall and swats it hard past extra cover, dominating start
gets the treatment, short outside off and McCullum takes full toll, smashes the poor thing miles over deep midwicket, was expecting the short one and gave it a spanking
back of a length on leg stump, tried to swing it past square leg, was struck on the ribs, no-ball, freehit coming up
McCullum charges out first ball, it's a short one on middle and McCullum had to readjust, played it down awkwardly into the leg side and lost his balance in the process
